question: Find the mean proportion between (p-q)/(p+q) and ((pq)²)/(p²-q²).
solution:
**Given:**

First number = (p-q)/(p+q)

Second number = ((pq)²)/(p²-q²)

**Formula used:**

Mean proportion = √(1st number × 2nd number)

**Calculation:**

Mean proportion = √(1st number × 2nd number)

⇒** ****√**((p-q)/(p+q) × ((pq)²)/(p²-q²))

⇒ √((p-q)/(p+q) × ((pq)²)/((p+q)(p - q)))

⇒ √{(pq)²/(p + q)²}

⇒ (pq)/(p + q)

**∴ The correct option is 3.**
